caption: The drawing depicts a metallic tankard with a hinged lid, a thumb lever, and an ornate handle, presented in grayscale pencil or ink on a light beige background. The main object, the tankard, appears centered and shown in a three-quarters perspective, revealing the cylindrical body that widens towards the base. The top has a large, flat, circular lid with a protruding thumb lever attached to the handle, which is thick, curved, and features decorative elements at the thumb rest and the lower joint. The body of the tankard is smooth with subtle shading to indicate metallic texture, and a small oval or circular mark (possibly a maker's mark) is present on the side facing the viewer. Around the base and lid edge, faint concentric ridges are visible. In the upper left corner, a smaller inset drawing provides a side view with measurements (6 1/4 inches high, 5 1/2 inches at the base, 6 1/2 inches from tip to handle edge, and the handle's thickness given as 1 1/4 inches), and the upper right corner contains another inset showing a sectional view of the tankard's vertical axis, revealing interior details and the mechanics of the handle and lid. The background of the drawing is entirely unadorned, and the name "Horace Pima" appears signed in script at the bottom right corner.
title: Silver Tankard
